title: Some users may experience delays receiving chat messages in Microsoft Teams
impactDescription: Users may see chat messages arrive several minutes late in the desktop and web clients.

description.content:
Title: Some users may experience delays receiving chat messages

User impact: Users may see chat messages arrive several minutes late.

Current status: We are reviewing service telemetry to identify the cause.

Current status: We identified a recent configuration change in a messaging component and are reverting it.

Next update by: Wednesday, October 15, 2026, at 10:00 AM UTC

Current status: The revert is 60% complete and delays are decreasing in monitored regions.

  • Affected: North America, Europe
  • Workaround: refresh the client
